title: Audit Taskfold session, projection and tasks UI
goal: Identify and substantiate defects or integration gaps in the supplied nukular-ai session, task list, projection dump and Accordion tasks UI without changing product code.

tasks.title: Orientation, Analysis, Scope & Objective clarification
acceptanceCriteria: Locate session, task list, projection and relevant implementation/revisions.

report.outcome: Located the 2,955-entry session, 1,132-line v2 task list and 9,047-line YAML dump. Current source and installed extension both resolve to e6e87a2; the dump contains 221,120 live versus 1,811,359 full estimated tokens.
decisions: Read-only investigation — no product edits or external disclosure of session content.
Use local implementation, SPEC-0002 and recorded tool details as authoritative evidence.

tasks.title: Audit session behavior and folding integrity

report.outcome: Established a reproduced migration regression and a planner starvation defect tied directly to the supplied session, plus six erased historical task nodes and repeated agent lifecycle violations. The latest source fixes historical add-under-finished behavior but does not repair existing affected sessions.

subtasks.title: Reconstruct task transitions, persisted metadata and anomalous session behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Identify session and task-list inconsistencies with exact evidence.

report.outcome: Reconstructed lifecycle errors, repeated premature stops and task-list divergence. Reproduced v1→v2 migration accepting deep legacy tasks then producing an unreadable v2 file; session lines 2440–2450 show this failure and manual deletion of six historical tasks to recover.
decisions: Separate agent protocol failures from conductor bugs — no recall/unfold calls occurred despite later re-investigation of completed work.
Latest list has 75 tasks (41 done, 27 todo, 5 abandoned, 2 doing); six completed/abandoned legacy descendants remain only in the transcript.
open: Trace projection record loss and UI metadata wiring next.
Earlier runtime allowed adding children to completed parents; current implementation rejects this, so distinguish historical behavior from current regressions.

subtasks.title: Trace conductor records, nesting, aging and recovery against the session
acceptanceCriteria: Validate suspected folding defects using source and focused reproductions.

report.outcome: Confirmed planner starvation of the historical 3.4.1 task: the completed parent ended before the child ran, parent compilation fails, and the ID-based roots exclude the child although it is individually foldable. Local replay saturated with safe child folds available; supplied dump leaves 61,706 calibrated tokens of 3.4.1 raw.
decisions: Do not treat local replay token totals as the historical wire — replay lacks the live provider calibration and historical folding epochs.
Observed aggressive archival of 3.5 removes the child outcome/handle association; agent then re-audits completed agent-filter work without using recall.
open: Projection duplicates shared groups, omits split carriers and loses structured details; investigate in next task.
UI steering appears to match group summary keys instead of composed task handles.

tasks.title: Audit projection dump and tasks UI feature parity

report.outcome: Audited all dump formats and native tasks surfaces. Verified wire fidelity defects, invalid YAML, metadata/working-set omissions, broken composed-child steering and interval attribution; the modern widget presentation is present but the inspection UI is not feature-complete.

subtasks.title: Check dump fidelity and metadata coverage
acceptanceCriteria: Compare outgoing dump content and fields to source contracts and recorded data.

report.outcome: Reproduced shared-record duplication, missing split/untracked carriers, raw paired-result leakage, and loss of structured metadata in dump construction. Supplied YAML fails parsing at line 2525 because literal indentation is inferred from an indented first content line; parsing an in-memory |2-adjusted copy yields 214,453 summed tokens versus 221,120 declared.
decisions: All five formats share the defective DumpDoc; flat is not a trustworthy escape hatch.

Dump excludes the transient working-set suffix and serializes neither the list goal/pins/attachments nor structured task details/handles. System text is intentionally count-only, but working-set omission is undocumented in the wire claim.
open: Verify UI composed-handle steering and interval attribution next.

subtasks.title: Check task panel, tree, widget and actions
acceptanceCriteria: Trace new task features through UI models, renderers and command ingress; reproduce concrete gaps where practical.

report.outcome: Confirmed composed-child handles work in core recall but the tasks panel refuses them as having no fold; task details omit goal, acceptance criteria, scoped pins and attachments. Interval-unaware views misattribute blocked sibling work, and rendering re-reads list files; invalid lists disappear from browser/widget.
decisions: Native widget has the new status glyphs, separate fold markers and width fitting; those parts are wired.
Existing focused suites: 96 tests passed across schema, conductor, dump/transcript and tasks UI. App Vitest command unavailable (vitest: command not found); no real terminal capture was performed.
open: Need summarize confirmed defects separately from intentional aging policy and agent misuse.

tasks.title: Synthesize ranked findings and verification limits
acceptanceCriteria: Present actionable evidence-backed findings distinguishing confirmed defects from limitations.

report.outcome: Prepared ranked findings separating reproduced implementation defects, historical migration damage, missing UI/dump feature parity and agent-protocol failures. Confirmed pre-flatten backup survives at /tmp/tui-full-integration.before-flatten.json; no tracked files changed.
decisions: Prioritize migration safety and truthful wire export before tuning folding pressure.
Retain classifier behavior as a positive control: important user instructions were kept; observed repetition is not evidence of incorrect classifier deletion.
open: No live /accordion terminal exercise or historical calibrated-wire replay was performed.
App test command could not run because the app's Vitest executable is not installed; 96 focused Bun tests passed despite uncovered defects.
